command: set -eu; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "a9e89bef5cf6cb3ec7300eeedb27803397ac1f78"; SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); test -n "$SERIAL"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/t0-result-ids.xml >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/t0-result-ids.xml | python3 -c 'import sys,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; r=ET.fromstring(sys.stdin.read()); texts=[n.attrib.get("text","") for n in r.iter() if n.attrib.get("text")]; start=next((i for i,t in enumerate(texts) if t=="Last T0 test"),0); print("\n".join(texts[start:]))'
